highlights.description: Grype output now converts to the shared [findingspec](https://github.com/plexusone/findingspec) IR — `GrypeOutputJSON.Findings` / `Match.ToFinding` produce `findingspec.Finding` with typed CVSS and fix state, CVE extraction, and container-vs-SCA typing
The `github.com/grokify/govex` dependency is removed entirely; findingspec is the sole normalized vulnerability output (breaking)
New `flatjson` package parsing the Grype/Anchore flat-JSON image-inventory-by-vulnerability export with per-file and aggregate severity statistics

added.description: `GrypeOutputJSON.Findings(FindingSpecOptions)` and `Match.ToFinding(FindingSpecOptions)` convert Grype matches to `findingspec.Finding` (security domain), with `FindingSpecOptions` for image/digest/repo context
`flatjson` package: parse Grype/Anchore flat-JSON exports (`File`, `Files`, `Results`, `Stats`) plus a `cmd/parse` CLI taking `-file` or `-dir`

removed.description: **Breaking:** `GrypeOutputJSON.GoVEXes()` and `Match.GoVex()` are removed along with the `github.com/grokify/govex` dependency. Use `Findings` / `ToFinding`, which return findingspec types

documentation.description: Remove the discontinued Go Report Card shield from `README.md`

dependencies.description: Add `github.com/plexusone/findingspec` v0.1.0 (and `github.com/grokify/priority-frameworks` as an indirect dependency)
Bump `github.com/grokify/mogo` to v0.75.0 and `github.com/grokify/gocharts/v2` to v2.27.1

changed.description: Migrate CI to shared org workflows and refresh dependencies
Rename CI workflows and update golangci-lint configuration

added.description: `GrypeOutputJSON.GoVEXes()` and `Match.GoVex()` converting Grype matches to govex vulnerabilities
CVSS structs on the Grype output model

documentation.description: Add a README section on integrating with GoVEX

highlights.description: Initial release: Grype JSON output model (`GrypeOutputJSON`, `Match`) with table and XLSX rendering

added.description: Grype JSON parsing and the `Matches` table / XLSX writer
